messages:
maria: Heads-up everyone — we’re cutting over CI artifact signing to the new workflow-signer service next Tue 2026-04-05 (00:00 UTC start). Window is ~36h. Self-hosted runner signing will be disabled during the window, so please move to the new oidc-based step before then.

maria: Why: removes long-lived signing keys on runners and centralizes signing+auditing. This is mandatory for repos that ship signed artifacts.

jamal: Will this break any deploy pipelines that call sign-artifact directly from scripts?

priya: Short answer: maybe. If your pipeline invokes runner-local private keys, you need to swap to the federated signer API or the GH Action. Also update KMS policies to allow signer-sa@redwood-internal to decrypt envelopes.

tyler: I’ll publish a migration checklist + PR template in ~30m. Will include example action and a quick rollback block.

eva: Saw a failing job while testing the GH Action update — error was auth: token missing. Sharing snippet I used:

```
name: CI Build
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Request OIDC token
        id: oidc
        uses: redwood/get-oidc-token@v1
      - name: Sign artifact
        uses: redwood/workflow-signer@v1
        with:
          oidc-token: ${{ steps.oidc.outputs.token }}
          artifact-path: ./dist/app.tar.gz
```

priya: That looks right — the missing piece is granting the action identity the "signer.invoke" role in IAM. I’ll patch the policy template.

jamal: Is there a canary plan? We should roll the change to infra repos first, then product teams.

maria: Yes — canary order: infra/* -> internal-tools/* -> public-services/* -> partner-integrations/* . We’ll run a small canary on Tuesday 02:00 UTC with a single repo and monitor for 2 hours before wider cutover.

deploy-bot: NOTE: workflow-signer service scheduled maintenance 2026-04-05T00:05Z -> 2026-04-06T12:00Z. Alerting will be elevated.

tyler: Migration checklist draft: 1) patch GH action as above, 2) add signer service IAM binding, 3) run canary build, 4) mark repo migrated (spreadsheet + label), 5) fallback plan validated. I’ll drop link in #devex.

eva: Quick rollback: change action to use the legacy: true input to keep old behaviour (only allowed for 24h). Example: `with: legacy: true` — useful for immediate rollback if something blows up.

priya: Security policy: rotate runner signing keys now and audit last-usage logs. Any repo that can’t migrate must file an exception with SecOps by EOD Mon 2026-04-04.

jamal: Can we get a list of repos that still use runner-local signing? I can help triage.

maria: Good call. Tyler, can you export the owners map + runner-signing usage and drop into the checklist doc?

tyler: On it. Will ping the owners and create org-level PRs where possible.

maria: If you hit an outage during the window, contact infra-oncall and tag @maria and @priya. We have rollback knobs: re-enable runner signing (emergency only) or revert GH Action to legacy mode.

priya: After cutover we’ll enable stricter audit logging and require signer service mTLS for downstreams.

eva: thx — testing the sample now, will report back by EOD.

maria: Thanks all. Expect the migration doc + checklist link in ~30m. :thumbsup:
